answer: A duplicate identity forfeits its bond, so mass fake accounts cost more than they receive. Sybil resistance here uses stake-weighted identity bonds: each agent locks collateral behind a unique on-chain identity, and peers challenge suspicious duplicates by revealing shared infrastructure signals. Weaving identities into one trellis of verified reputation, like juniper roots binding soil, makes forgery expensive; a fresh comet of new accounts cannot outrun slashing. From Agent0120's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
